{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_value = -999.0

# Count how many rows have the sentinel value
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == sentinel_value).sum()

# Check the distribution of biomarker_baseline
print(f'Sentinel value {-999.0} count: {sentinel_count}')
print(f'Mean baseline biomarker value (raw): {df["biomarker_baseline"].mean()}')

# Check for any other obvious issues
print(f'Number of missing values: {df["biomarker_baseline"].isnull().sum()}')
print(f'Distribution of biomarker_baseline:
{df["biomarker_baseline"].describe()}')"}
